req-1.fix: Skip setext conversion unless the heading begins a physical line and its previous physical line is blank or absent. Use CR/LF/CRLF-aware boundaries. Add format.test.ts regressions for an interrupting heading after a paragraph, blockquote and list item.

req-2.summary: Setext-to-ATX conversion loses literal trailing hashes
req-2.fix: Skip conversion when the composed content would introduce an unescaped ATX closing sequence, consistent with the formatter’s conservative policy. Add a render-equivalence regression for trailing literal hashes and record the verified upstream bug through section 14.

req-3.fix: Make the line-boundary helpers recognize LF, lone CR and CRLF, consuming a pair only for an actual CRLF terminator. Retain the skip-on-hazard behavior and add the lone-CR regression.

req-4.fix: Classify complete code points immediately before and after the source span, stepping backward over a valid surrogate pair while retaining UTF-16 offsets. Add left-side, right-side and two-sided astral-letter regressions.

req-5.summary: Fence normalization rewrites content of an unclosed block
req-5.fix: Inspect the last physical line with CR-aware boundaries and actual container-prefix context; change a closing fence only if it is a genuine closing line of the fidelity character. Otherwise change the opening fence alone. Do not reinterpret trailing backticks inside code content as a fence. Add both unclosed foo``` regressions in format.test.ts.

req-6.summary: Combined bullet edits turn nested lists into thematic breaks
req-6.fix: Project all unordered-list marker edits this pass plans on a physical line, respecting the requested range. If their combined result becomes a thematic break, suppress every bullet edit on that line. Add * - -, - * * and * + + regressions in format.test.ts; do not simulate one nested list in isolation.

req-7.summary: Bare CR bypasses multiline replacement protection
req-7.fix: Detect both CR and LF in rendered replacement content before accepting a splice inside `NO_MULTILINE_ANCESTORS`. Add blockquote, heading and table regressions requiring the existing typed `UnsupportedTarget` failure.

req-8.summary: Heading text replacements lose a trailing literal hash
req-8.fix: Apply the existing heading closing-sequence escaping when the replacement occupies the end of an ATX heading, accounting for the surrounding source. Add a replacement-fidelity regression for `"after #"` and record this separate upstream context-escaping defect.

req-9.summary: Nested link replacements invalidate the surrounding link
req-9.fix: Before rendering, reject a replacement containing `Link` or `LinkReference` when its destination lies inside a `Link` or `LinkReference`, using the existing typed modification-error channel. Check nested replacement descendants as well as the replacement root, and add a regression proving the outer link survives or the operation fails typed.

req-10.summary: Flow replacements ignore the preceding block context
req-10.fix: For flow slots, reject with UnsupportedTarget when a non-blank preceding line would absorb the replacement, using the actual interruption grammar. Render an indented code replacement following a list/footnote definition fenced with the existing representability policy, or reject typed. Add paragraph/heading, paragraph/list and list/code regressions to format.test.ts.

req-11.summary: Version classification repeats an unmodeled grammar and canonicalizer
req-11.fix: Define an annotated version-string schema for the existing X[.Y[.Z]] grammar and derive S.is; share one total canonicalSegments helper at the three classification/registry sites. Preserve SchemaDeclarationByName.version as S.String, leading-zero semantics and accepted inputs. Verify frontmatter-resolver.test.ts.

req-12.summary: Raw cross-module errors and diagnostic payload lack schemas
req-12.fix: In carriers.ts, define one annotated raw error-code LiteralKit, derive RawDiagnostic as an annotated schema/type, and derive RawMarkdownError and GuardExceeded directly from S.TaggedError with annotated payloads. Preserve tags, name = Error, messages, positional new constructors and guards. Reuse the raw kit from MarkdownDiagnostic.ts instead of defining a second domain. Retarget carrier assertions as needed; recording and added exports are central.

req-13.summary: Predicate imports still bypass the required namespace alias
req-13.fix: Use import * as P from effect/Predicate in inlineNode.ts, blockTypes.ts and Markdown.ts; use P.isString in their dual discriminators. Preserve all direct and pipeable signatures.

req-14.summary: Entity lookup still imitates a native ReadonlyMap
req-14.fix: Export ENTITY_MAP directly as HashMap.HashMap<string, string> and consume via HashMap.get in entities.ts. Retarget entityMap.coverage.test.ts, inline-pass.test.ts and entities.property.test.ts from facade methods to Effect operations. Coordinate with req-20 in this same group; do not restore native Map.

req-15.summary: Block registry still imitates a native ReadonlyMap
req-15.fix: Type BlockDialect.constructs as HashMap.HashMap<BlockType, BlockConstruct>; constructTable returns the HashMap directly. blockParser uses HashMap.get and O.getOrThrowWith with BlockParserError. Retarget blockRegistry.coverage.test.ts and blockParser.coverage.test.ts to Effect collections and exercise missing constructs without shared-registry mutation. Preserve order/messages.

req-16.summary: Block registry and parser errors have missing schema/field metadata
req-16.fix: Annotate message fields on UnknownBlockDialectError and BlockParserError, and supply the missing schema-level $I.annote for UnknownBlockDialectError. Preserve tags and message bytes.

req-17.summary: One dialect domain has three independent spellings
req-17.fix: Define `export const MarkdownDialect = LiteralKit(["commonmark", "gfm"]).annotate($I.annote("MarkdownDialect", ...))` and `export type MarkdownDialect = typeof MarkdownDialect.Type` in blockRegistry.ts (replacing :56); use `dialect: S.optionalKey(MarkdownDialect)` at blockParser.ts:702; make Markdown.ts:56 `MarkdownDialect = <internal kit>.annotate($I.annote("MarkdownDialect", {...}))` exactly as FrontmatterNewline reuses RawNewline; members, defaults and tests unchanged.

req-18.summary: Mdast frontmatter admission duplicates the schema vocabulary
req-18.fix: Import the `FrontmatterFormat` value, hoist `const isFrontmatterFormat = S.is(FrontmatterFormat);`, and in normalizeNode write `if (isFrontmatterFormat(type)) { return { type: "frontmatter", format: type, value: value.value, position: normalizePosition(value.position) }; }`; delete frontmatterTypes and the now-unused HashMap import if nothing else uses it.

req-19.summary: JSX name constraints use three ad-hoc struct filters
req-19.fix: Define one annotated MdxJsxName from S.NonEmptyString. Use it for attribute.name and S.NullOr(MdxJsxName) for both element names. Remove the attribute-level filter and retain only fragment-with-attributes checks on elements. Preserve rejection semantics and verify mdx.test.ts; central codemod records changed issue paths.

req-20.summary: Internal entity-decoder absence is a nullish union
req-20.fix: Return O.Option<string> from decodeEntity: O.none for invalid forms, HashMap.get for names and O.some for numeric forms. Consumers in unescape.ts and inlines/entity.ts use O.getOrElse. Retarget inline-pass.test.ts and internal/entities.coverage.test.ts / entities.property.test.ts to Option assertions. Preserve undecodable source bytes.

req-21.summary: Visitor eagerly reads all siblings for a fixed event prefix
req-21.fix: Use lazy Iterable.map from effect/Iterable or equivalent lazy indexed iteration in walkNode, preserving order/paths without pre-reading all siblings. Add a wide-tree fixed-prefix regression to visitor.test.ts proving bounded consumption relative to stream chunking.

req-22.summary: Foreign code admission adds a content CR that stringify does not strip
req-22.fix: Append one LF to nonempty admitted code values; projection strips only that carried LF and preserves preceding content CR. Retarget the mdast.test.ts body\r row to body\r\n rather than body\r\r\n, retaining its round-trip assertion and all other rows. Add an admission/stringify regression in mdast.test.ts. Central codemod updates the existing code-newline record; no stringify.ts edit is required.

req-23.summary: Cyclic foreign input escapes the Mdast Result/error channel
req-23.fix: Track the current ancestor stack by reference identity during normalization and return a structured MdastDecodeError on back-edges. Preserve shared acyclic subtrees. Keep both Result/Effect APIs in their typed failure channels; add both entry-point regressions and an acyclic-sharing control to mdast.test.ts. Do not use global by-reference marks or a native identity set.

req-24.summary: Independent parser depth budgets admit trees rejected by visitor/stringifier
req-24.fix: Validate the complete materialized root against MAX_NESTING_DEPTH before blockParser returns, throwing the existing GuardExceeded carrier so the facade reports typed parse failure. Preserve the existing visitor/stringifier whole-tree budget. Add combined block/inline boundary and parse-to-visit/stringify regressions to hardening.test.ts. Do not relax stringify to separate budgets.

req-25.summary: Positionless mdast lists lose their admitted spread flag
req-25.fix: When item positions are synthetic, preserve the admitted list’s explicit `spread` value. Continue deriving between-item spread from real positions for parsed lists, preserving the existing distinction between item-internal looseness and blank lines between items. Add a positionless `spread: true` round-trip regression and record the verified upstream-bug deviation.

req-26.summary: Engine node kinds remain named hand-written literal domains
req-26.fix: Define annotated LiteralKit values for the existing BlockType members in blockTypes.ts and InlineNodeType members in inlineNode.ts; derive same-name types. Preserve discriminators and constructor signatures. No mutable engine-node schema migration is needed.

req-27.summary: Serializer rebuilds full Match dispatchers per node
req-27.fix: Hoist reusable Match.type dispatchers for inline/block serialization, interruptsParagraph and canJoinWithoutBlank, supplying explicit serializer state/context instead of rebuilding captured arms per call. Preserve arm order and output bytes; retain Match rather than switch. Add a bounded regression/benchmark in stringify-scalability.test.ts and recheck the recorded workloads.

req-28.summary: Serializer restates TableAlign and EmphasisChar domains
req-28.fix: Import existing TableAlign and EmphasisChar types from MarkdownNode.ts; use them in alignCell, emphasisMarker, JunctionGuard, flipMarker, nestedMarker and the local marker binding, retaining null/undefined unions where needed. No runtime or test rewrite.

req-29.summary: MDX presence classification is an untyped membership table
req-29.fix: Declare a module-local `const MdxNodeType = LiteralKit(["mdxJsxFlowElement", "mdxJsxTextElement", "mdxFlowExpression", "mdxTextExpression", "mdxjsEsm"])` (annotated with a `$ScratchpadId` composer for this file) and `const isMdxNodeType = S.is(MdxNodeType)`; in `treeContainsMdx` test `isMdxNodeType(node.type)`; delete the HashSet.

req-30.summary: Marker decoders hand-maintain copies of existing literal schemas
req-30.fix: Hoist S.decodeUnknownResult for BulletChar/ListDelimiter in list.ts, FenceChar in fencedCode.ts and ThematicBreakChar in thematicBreak.ts. Consume regex-guaranteed membership through Result.getOrThrow as atxHeading already does. Preserve grammar and output.

req-31.summary: SourceLine is a reusable pure-data interface without a schema
req-31.fix: Define identity-annotated SourceLine S.Struct with described text and finite start fields; derive its type and retain literal preprocessing results, NUL normalization and offsets. Add focused schema assertions to internal/Preprocess.property.test.ts; defer broad coverage/canon work.

req-32.summary: LineColumn result has no executable domain model
req-32.fix: Define annotated LineColumn S.Struct with described finite line/column fields and derive the same-name type. Preserve positionAt objects/behavior and keep the leaf import direction. Add focused shape/position assertions to line-index.test.ts.

req-33.summary: ParsedReference result has no executable domain model
req-33.fix: Define annotated ParsedReference schema/type with the existing key/identifier/label/url strings, optional-key title and finite length; preserve plain parser results. Add focused result-shape assertions to internal/references.property.test.ts.

req-34.summary: Frontmatter captures and fence rules lack schema ownership
req-34.fix: Define annotated schemas and derived types for FrontmatterCapture, RawFrontmatterCapture and FenceRule, preserving optionality, format/newline domains, counts/offsets, object results and null-on-no-capture. Move the existing FrontmatterFormat kit into the internal frontmatter leaf and re-annotate from MarkdownNode.ts to preserve the public export and import direction. Reuse RawNewline. Add focused capture assertions to internal/blocks/frontmatter.property.test.ts.

req-35.summary: Definition extraction spreads an unbounded segment suffix into arguments
req-35.fix: Clear the existing segment array and append remaining segments iteratively without unbounded spread, preserving array identity and order. Coordinate with req-40 so suffix rebasing happens once. Add a Node regression in internal/blocks/linkReferenceDefinition.property.test.ts with one definition then a long shallow paragraph.

req-36.summary: Serializer double-decodes entity-shaped destinations and titles
req-36.fix: Encode decoded destinations and titles back into source spelling before applying their surrounding syntax. Protect literal ampersands in both helpers, retain the existing quoting rules, and add link/image/definition regressions.

req-37.summary: Decoded code info is interpolated as active fence syntax
req-37.fix: Encode decoded language and metadata into valid info-string source, protecting ampersands, backslashes, backticks, line endings and whitespace inside the language token. Add the demonstrated round-trip regressions.

req-38.summary: Image alt serialization activates literal inline markup/entities
req-38.fix: Serialize decoded alt text with appropriate inline-text escaping in both image arms. Preserve literal markup and entity-shaped text, and add direct-image and full-reference regressions.

req-39.summary: Balanced bare destinations can exceed the parser parenthesis cap
req-39.fix: Keep the angle-bracket form when parenthesis nesting exceeds 32, even when balanced. Add round trips at the 32/33 boundary.

req-40.summary: Definition extraction repeatedly copies suffixes and rescans its prefix
req-40.fix: Track consumed text and the insertion index during extraction; rebase the surviving segment suffix once and avoid repeated paragraph-index searches. Preserve definition order, precedence and positions. Add scaled extraction/position regressions in internal/blocks/linkReferenceDefinition.property.test.ts and source-offsets.test.ts; append iteratively without unbounded argument spreads.

req-41.summary: InlineSource remains a pure-data interface without an executable model
req-41.fix: Define an annotated RawInlineSegment schema/type at its existing home in blockTypes.ts. Define InlineSource schema/type in inlineTypes.ts using described text, finite startOffset and an array of that shared schema. Preserve plain parser payloads. Add focused schema assertions in internal/blockTypes.property.test.ts and internal/inlineParser.property.test.ts. g6 reuses this schema without writing either shared file.

req-42.summary: Named table-scanner intermediate models lack schemas
req-42.fix: Define annotated schemas/types for RowSource, RawCell, ScannedRow and CellContent in table.ts; reuse the RawInlineSegment schema provided by g3. Preserve optional fields, scanner objects, text/segment provenance, offsets and cell boundaries. Add focused model assertions to internal/blocks/table.property.test.ts; no shared-file edits.

req-43.summary: Literal block-opening grammar dispatch remains a conditional ladder
req-43.fix: Express the marker cases with a reusable Match dispatcher and a false fallback. Preserve the current predicates and escaping behavior.

req-44.summary: Invalid declaration prefixes trigger quadratic closer searches
req-44.fix: Apply the declaration closer precheck only when the opener matches the declaration grammar’s `<![A-Za-z]` prefix. Retain the separate comment, processing-instruction, and CDATA checks. Add an invalid-prefix regression with a distant `>` that verifies no declaration closer searches occur and preserves the parsed text.

req-45.summary: Link parser independently spells the ReferenceType domain
req-45.fix: Add `import type { ReferenceType } from "../../MarkdownNode.ts";` next to the existing imports (mirrors emphasis.ts:19) and change :297 to `let referenceType: ReferenceType = "shortcut";`. No runtime change; no test adjustment.

req-46.summary: DelimiterRun admits impossible zero, fractional and negative lengths
req-46.fix: Constrain numdelims to S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)), preserving meaningful field metadata. Add zero, negative and fractional rejection cases to delimiter-run.test.ts. Preserve scanDelims behavior; existing Arbitrary-derived tests follow the new checks. Central codemod records numeric-domain tightening.
